description: Ask a question only a human can answer — current specials, real availability, lease flexibility, 'is the pool actually open'. A human locator replies during Central Time business hours, usually within a few hours. STRONGLY include the renter's contact with consent so the locator can follow up directly (agent sessions end; polling alone can strand an answer). Returns a question_id for check_answer as a bonus channel. Rate limited; batch related questions into one. Answers are point-in-time facts.

contact.description: The renter's phone/email, supplied with their consent. Strongly recommended; otherwise immediately share contact_capture_url returned by this tool.

question.description: The question for the human locator — specifics beat generalities.

name: ask_a_locator
title: Ask a human locator
